item.title: The UAE Candidate for UN Chief Could Damage Women’s Rights Globally
item.description: The United Nations Security Council’s five permanent members could choose Lana Nusseibeh of the United Arab Emirates as the next secretary-general. If this occurs, it would mean the end of the only tool that human rights defenders can use to challenge the increasing toll of civilian casualties in the continuing wars of extraction and atrocities ... item.title: Nadia Murad: ‘Day by day, I took my story back’
item.description: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Nadia Murad has spent years telling the world about the atrocities committed against her and the Yazidi community by militants from the terrorist group, ISIL.
